response.sql: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX HAVING AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) IS NOT NULL), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM sex_averages), above_first AS (SELECT s.avg_ratio FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE s.avg_ratio > m.value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(a.avg_ratio - f.value) AS average_above_first_mean, AVG(a.avg_ratio - s.value) AS average_above_second_mean FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE a.avg_ratio > s.value

assumptions.assumption: A NULL SEX is treated as one group; a zero GPT makes the ratio undefined and is ignored.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude patients whose SEX is NULL.
